creativeThesis: Let beautiful grain geometry become a legible map of stillness, using motion contrast before terminology.
viewerExperience: A pattern appears in close view; a slowed cross-section exposes why grains settle; return to the same image with a changed mental model.
emotionalTarget: Mesmerized curiosity followed by a crisp reversal of intuition.
visualThesis: Graphite metal under grazing light, off-white granular traces, restrained copper moving-region marks and mint nodal marks only when explanation needs them. The plate fills the field; material close views and side-view motion replace recurring headline cards.

decisions.treatment: Original deterministic SVG granular plate choreography plus a slowed side-view displacement illustration.
decisions.rationale: Directly contrast mobile grains/moving regions with stationary nodes. Controlled qualitative visualization can reveal the mechanism without borrowed experimental footage.
alternativesConsidered: Bright physical tabletop documentary with macro sand footage and a short side-view insert.
Full-field abstract signed displacement maps with contours and no physical plate.

decisions.treatment: Charcoal/graphite material scene, pale grains, copper motion and mint still-node annotations; no dashboard, grid of cards or per-beat heading. Close views occupy usable space.
decisions.rationale: Grazing metallic contrast makes tiny grains visible; colors encode motion distinction, not domain or inherited palette.

decisions.treatment: Kokoro-local af_heart, 0.97 speed, intrigued then precise; authored holds at pattern formation and final contrast.
decisions.rationale: Current primary narrator by brand policy; no domain-based audition.

decisions.treatment: Large off-white Manrope speech phrases with fixed glyph placement and short opacity fades, left-aligned in a clear lower field; no word bounce/backplate.
decisions.rationale: Silent viewer can follow the causal reversal without losing grains or the meaningful qualifier can. Existing font deliberately chosen for neutral readable experimental labeling, not copied caption design.

decisions.treatment: Two short original low-level synthesized tones at illustrative mode demonstrations; silence through the causal side view and voice clearly foregrounded. No music bed.
decisions.rationale: Make excitation audible without pretending to record/calibrate the plate. Persistent disclosure says tones illustrative; frequency values never appear.

decisions.treatment: Measured speech plus short visual-only formation/reset holds and brief payoff hold.
decisions.rationale: The process needs time to see grains move; story-led duration with no threshold padding or inherited runtime.

decisions.treatment: Grains converge into a figure immediately, opening narration states vibration as cause; no prefatory title card.
decisions.rationale: Show the phenomenon that the explanation will resolve.

decisions.treatment: Bind four provisional playback profiles before rendering. Critical grains/labels/captions inside surviving insets; native geometry/crops/device behavior remain unknown.
decisions.rationale: Preflight is required production evidence; post-master adaptation and release preparation wait for owner master approval.

convergenceReview.conclusion: Similarity is allowed when the experiment and accessibility justify it. Convenience-driven spatial habits were explored internally and resolved with close material process, side view and no repetitive card/headline stack; no forced light/dark alternation.

portfolioReview.selectionRationale: Exact four latest available approved masters by decision-entry time; all inspected rendered sheets and available direction bodies; no publication/performance filter.
portfolioReview.proposedFeedImpression: A near-field experimental material scene with bright granular lines on graphite metal, no repeating title/proof/caption card stack. Affinity to Traffic darkness is descriptive, not a reason to choose it.
portfolioReview.toolingBiasCheck: Existing SVG/Remotion capability could encourage yet another small center-object explainer. Explicit materially different tabletop and field-map alternatives were explored; chosen original grain scene must fill usable frame and prioritize continuous physical cause. No renderer/assets/style convenience grants preference.

ownerReview.rationale: Routine V3 internal direction under existing local tooling, narrator, rights and costs; no exceptional policy change.

risks: Illustrative grains must settle at rendered nodal lines.
Slowed side view must keep nodes fixed while adjacent lobes move.
Tones must not imply calibrated pattern-to-frequency correspondence.
Captions and model disclosure must remain legible; exact mobile/native/crop unknown.

provenance.notes: Session-authored source-inspected V3 internal readiness; no owner direction approval or provider run fabricated.
